remaining_blockers.core_income_parent: Market-specific earnings normalization policy and source reconciliation remain unresolved; all three years retain null.
remaining_blockers.audit_opinion: Not mapped in this extension; original auditor report still requires explicit structured audit review.
remaining_blockers.valuation: No date-matched total company market capitalization and CNY conversion in this extension.
remaining_blockers.peer_coverage: Only one Hong Kong issuer; cannot form an adequate same-market/industry ranking group.
remaining_blockers.historical_availability: Annual report dates are conservative dates for these specific immutable documents. 2022 values here become available with 2023 report in 2024, not retroactively in 2023. Earlier results announcements and restatement chain are not reconstructed.
remaining_blockers.enterprise_release: No approval to run this as an unattended enterprise investment-selection system is implied by field reconciliation.

cash_policy: Use reported cash equivalents for the narrow net-debt diagnostic. Restricted deposits are excluded. Term deposits and accrued interest are explicitly separated; cross-border remittance constraints remain relevant.
earnings_policy: Keep consolidated net income and owners profit distinct. Do not set HK core_income_parent to reported profit or to a narrow company-specific adjusted figure.
